    Why TALO?

    TALO comes from Talos, the mythical bronze automaton of ancient Greece and one of the earliest concepts of an artificial, human-made machine.

    TALO Engine brings that idea into the future of building services.

    The name honours Talos in his crested helmet, keeper of the daily patrol around the island of Crete. The single vein that carried his life, sealed with a bronze nail, is where the story of automation and fragility begins.

    FAQs

    What does TALO Engine actually deliver?

    Coordinated MEP models, clash-checked and issued to a defined standard, plus the drawings and schedules that come off them — backed by implementation advice so your team can run the same workflow after handover.

    Which software and standards do you work in?

    Revit-based BIM to UK BS EN ISO 19650 workflows as standard, with AI-assisted automation layered on top to speed up coordination and QA. Other platforms and standards can be discussed on a project basis.

    How is a project scoped and priced?

    Every engagement starts with a short scoping call to understand the project stage, deliverables and programme, followed by a fixed-fee or stage-based proposal — there's no standard rate card because scope varies project to project.

    Do you work with in-house teams or as an outsourced service?

    Both. Some clients bring TALO Engine in to run coordination end-to-end; others use it to extend an existing team's capacity or to set up an automated workflow they then own internally.

    Where are you based, and do you work internationally?

    TALO Engine is UK-based with international project experience, and works with clients remotely as standard.
